question: How do I start a new club?
answer:
To start a new club at Vista Ridge High School, you’ll need to complete the required documents and follow these steps:

1. Access and complete the [new club/organization request packet](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-gTgT9VXpYRzu282hvCj2gJBO5Up-6YIllXjH3F2RZ4/copy).

2. Fill out the annual [club request packet](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfUHFkxnE59hUt7lz6eDlHG6sNp4Bx14o2VKGETAA-FTKBVVw/viewform?usp=dialog) online. This is required for both new and existing clubs.

3. If your club will be handling money (like dues or fundraising), you’ll also need to submit a completed copy of your club’s by-laws along with the online packet. You can find relevant requirements here: [Bona Fide Student Group Information and Requirements](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/vrhs-finance/bona-fide-student-club-requirements).

4. Be sure a sponsor and student leaders are involved in completing the application.

5. For questions or further assistance, you are instructed to contact Dr. Peabody or Ms. Kelly.

Additionally, parents must complete a section of student registration that gives permission for their child to participate in clubs using the [VRHS Parent Club Permission Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeV_IbwuHeO7O9gEoJpCi7QZCSE7rbiydSLyIS0lX4hEmtSlQ/viewform?usp=dialog).

If you need further help, you can contact Dr. Peabody, Ms. Kelly, or check with the front office. Good luck with your new club!
